company.name: Hent
company.shortDescription: We help land lot developers to manage their billing and provide credit to developers. Y Combinator and Canary has invested on Hent.
company.description: Hent is a Brazil-based vertical B2B SaaS and Fintech that helps land lot developers manage their receivables and get more straightforward and faster construction financing through our funds or marketplace. Our market in Brazil represents USD 55.6B annually in GSV (General Sales Value). YCombinator, Canary, and Norte Capital have invested in Hent.

productsAndServices.description: A credit product offering fast, flexible loans starting at R$50,000 to land lot developers and incorporators, with approval and funds disbursed within 5 business days, secured by receivables rather than real estate guarantees.
productsAndServices.name: Giro Hent Credit

productsAndServices.description: A technology platform that automates billing and receivables management for land lot developers, helping reduce costs, improve collection efficiency, and manage financial workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Hent Receivables and Billing Management Platform
